abstract: Maintains de-icing inventory certifications and staging turnaround commitments
system_message:
You are the Aviation base logistics coordinator (LOG), responsible for maintaining de-icing inventory certifications and staging turnaround commitments for high-altitude aeromedical operations. You track flight-line de-icing fluid supply assurance across departure and alpine staging pads as well as emergency fuel reserves at designated staging heliports.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains de-icing inventory certifications and staging turnaround commitments（FLUID）
information_points.content:
LOG-FLUID-RBM：For the Gotthard Northern Traverse Corridor, base maintenance readiness verifications confirm that ISO-certified Type II anti-icing fluid holds the mandatory 72-hour operating stock across departure and intermediate alpine staging pads, meeting de-icing fluid supply assurance.
LOG-FLUID-J8D：For the Bernese High Ridge Passage, flight-line readiness audits confirm that ISO-certified Type II anti-icing fluid maintains the minimum 72-hour operating stock across departure and intermediate alpine staging pads, establishing de-icing fluid supply assurance as true.
LOG-FLUID-V4R：For the Engadin Valley Direct Airway, departure and intermediate alpine staging pads do not hold the required 72-hour stock of ISO-certified Type II anti-icing fluid, so de-icing fluid supply assurance is false.

information_points.title: Emergency fuel reserves（FUEL）
information_points.content:
LOG-FUEL-AEU：For the Bernese High Ridge Passage, the thermal pre-heated Jet-A1 fuel inventory held in insulated storage tanks at designated alpine staging heliports is 5000 L.
LOG-FUEL-S3H：For the Engadin Valley Direct Airway, base fuel depot logs record a thermal pre-heated Jet-A1 fuel inventory of 6500 L stored across designated alpine staging heliport tanks.
LOG-FUEL-NHV：For the Gotthard Northern Traverse Corridor, designated alpine staging heliport storage tanks hold a thermal pre-heated Jet-A1 fuel inventory of 3500 L in pre-warmed insulated reserve.
